name: Opus Picks-and-Shovels

orders.reason: Power-generation thesis de-rated; negative momentum on 3m/6m/12m, lags even weak IPP peers - dead money
ODM momentum broken (-16% 3m, -12% 1m); thin-margin box assembly better expressed via higher-quality WFE
Exhaustion after +633%/12m - 3m rolled over to -16%; lock the gain, connectivity covered by CRDO/ANET/ALAB
Semi WFE leader with fresh +46% 3m momentum, levered to HBM and advanced-logic capex, less frothy than memory
Scale-up interconnect leader (PCIe/CXL/NVLink fabric), +101% 3m - the AI-cluster connectivity bottleneck
nVent electrical connection + liquid cooling, cleanest uptrend among electrical names (+19% 3m) - under-priced datacenter power/thermal shovel

outlook: AI-infrastructure supply remains the tightest link in the chain; I stay concentrated in memory, semi-equipment, interconnect and datacenter power while pruning exhausted (LITE) and de-rated (CEG) names for fresher momentum. Main risk is a memory/storage-led unwind, so MU is the one high-beta position I'm consciously carrying on structural HBM tightness rather than momentum alone.
